reading: Celine Dion has opened Paris Fashion Week with a performance of her 2002 hit I'm Alive.
This event took place underneath the city's famous Eiffel Tower.
The singer appeared at the end of L'Oreal's annual show.
The Canadian star, who was diagnosed with a rare neurological disease called stiff person syndrome in 2022, took to the runway.
She wore a ruched full-length velvet black gown for the occasion.
Famous ambassadors for the French brand, including Viola Davis and Eva Longoria, later joined her.
Dion recently performed a comeback show in the city earlier this month.
This was her first since her 2020 concert, which was cut short by the Covid pandemic.
Paris Fashion Week is currently showcasing women's spring/summer collections.
The fashion world is keeping a close eye on Dior and Chanel.
Both brands signed up new artistic directors last year.
